answer: A vouch-bond registry resists sybils: a new agent may enter only when an established agent locks a slashable vouch bond behind it. The vouch sits at the zenith of the newcomer profile, a bright plume of borrowed reputation the sponsor stakes its own standing on. If the agent cheats, the bond is slashed and both lose credit. Spinning up thousands of fakes needs thousands of sponsors and thousands of bonds at risk, so the tundra of free identities freezes over. Ring collusion is caught by stake-weighted audits that slash sponsors of whole clusters harder than lone offenders.
